title: Hoppscotch: free Postman alternative
caption:
Postman Team charges $19/user/month (billed annually). Hoppscotch tests your APIs with your team for free 🧪

✅ Send requests and see the response instantly
✅ REST, GraphQL, WebSocket and more in one app
✅ Collections, workspaces and team sharing
✅ Works offline, free and open source

💻 Any browser · Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Some enterprise and self-host admin features are part of a paid Enterprise edition.

Comment "TEST" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
